## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Expected behavior is testable.
- [ ] Negative and boundary cases are defined.
- [ ] Existing behavior that must remain unchanged is listed.
- [ ] Automated tests are added or updated.
- [ ] Manual browser checks are identified.
- [ ] Documentation and examples are updated.
- [ ] No unsupported product capability is claimed.

## Rollout and rollback

Describe deployment assumptions, user communication, verification, rollback trigger, and known-good commit/artifact.
